newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 seen powering towards all-time high.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 seen powering towards all-time high.

text.p: UK shares were expected to open higher on Wednesday after U.S. stocks soared following economic data which renewed optimism over interest rates.
"I expect we'll sail through the closing high early on," said one equity salesman. "It's not the kind of thing you would expect on the eve of a general election."
The Dow closed 179 points, or 2.65 percent, higher at 6,962 on Tuesday in its second-largest, single-day, point rise in history.
The U.S. share index was trading 100 points higher as London markets closed. Traders here expected the FTSE 100 index to open between 25 and 40 points higher in response.
